summary: Independently reconstructed current PCAE capability state from primary evidence, not phase-number momentum: built a current capability map (governed execution-attempt boundary, Runtime Enforcement, Permission Broker foundation/production consumption, Authority Evaluation, Interactive Workflow, Publication/CHGR, Repository Intelligence, Historical Memory, Typed Authority Model, Advisory Governance, Lifecycle finalization, Prompt Generation, Prompt Dispatch, Agent invocation, Mutation governance, Rollback, Execution availability, Goal/work selection); built a repository-wide mutation inventory that extends Chapter 148's own count -- beyond the 2 Permission-Broker-gated pcae push dispatch sites (push.py:698, push.py:898), found real, CLI-reachable, ungated mutation capability in src/pcae/core/agent.py (commit_file_changes real git commit at agent.py:4567/4580, push_file_changes real git push at agent.py:4732/4755 reachable via 'pcae remote push', execute_rollback real git revert at agent.py:5107 reachable via 'pcae remote rollback execute', push_rollback real git push at agent.py:5219 reachable via 'pcae remote rollback push') and two more real git-push dispatch sites in src/pcae/commands/phase.py (backend-created-output-adoption-push-execution at phase.py:19563, final-verification-tooling-push-decision at phase.py:20295), none Permission-Broker-gated -- of >=8 real CLI-reachable mutation entry points, exactly 2 (both inside the pcae push MVP) are broker-gated. Separately assessed Prompt Creation (Phase 45F remains design-only: build_prompt_generation_design() at agent.py:11200-11229 returns static hardcoded dicts, no live construction from real data; CanonicalPrompt model exists with 13 fields -- identity and task binding present, context provenance/runtime target/authority references/freshness-digest fields missing) and Prompt Dispatch/agent invocation (entirely absent -- no code in src/pcae/ calls any LLM backend; only string-based secret-redaction keyword matches and Telegram notification urllib calls found). Assessed Runtime Enforcement (an unconnected, parallel design track per PBPC-001 Section 25 -- neither push.py nor commit.py imports or references it, not required for v1.0) and Runtime Capability Activation (no complete prerequisite argument exists; blocked on mutation coverage, Prompt Creation, Prompt Dispatch, rollback governance, and audit). Assessed rollback (real git-revert/git-push code exists in agent.py, CLI-reachable, ungated -- same gap as commit/push) and goal/work selection (resolve_next_task_title() in core/tasks.py is purely deterministic -- human title, else first pending TODO, else first roadmap item; no autonomous scoring). Built a full Candidate Comparison Matrix across Repository-Wide Mutation Permission Coverage, Prompt Creation, Prompt Dispatch, Runtime Capability Activation, Rollback/Recovery, and Goal/Work Selection, and a dependency graph showing mutation coverage and Prompt Creation are not mutually dependent, while Prompt Dispatch depends on Prompt Creation and Runtime Activation depends on all of the above. Verdict: SELECTED NEXT STRATEGIC CAPABILITY -- Repository-Wide Mutation Permission Coverage (architecture/inventory phase first, proposed 149B -- not authorized for implementation by this document); rationale: closes a real, already-live, CLI-reachable ungated mutation perimeter, is foundational to any future autonomous mutation, reuses the proven PBPC-001 pattern, can be strictly bounded as architecture/inventory rather than immediate wiring, and introduces no new execution risk. Prompt Creation ranked a strong, not-foreclosed second (no mutation effect, could be implemented safely, but does not address an already-live governance gap). Prompt Dispatch, Runtime Capability Activation not selected -- dependencies not met / no complete prerequisite argument. This phase is assessment-only: no production code, contract, or POL-001..012 meaning was changed; no new Permission Broker production consumer was added; no additional mutation path was activated; no Prompt Generation, Prompt Dispatch, or agent invocation capability was implemented; no runtime execution capability was enabled. Production diff: git diff --name-only dccc6e16..HEAD -- src/pcae/ empty. Contract diff: git diff --name-only dccc6e16..HEAD -- docs/contracts/ empty (PBPC-001 remains v1.2, PBPA-001 remains v1.0). Runtime reconfirmed Observed/observe/unavailable before and after. See docs/PHASE_149A_NEXT_STRATEGIC_CAPABILITY_REASSESSMENT.md for full detail.
